I am a PhD Candidate in Economics at the University of Warwick.

I am also an Affiliated Scholar at the [Data, Policy and Innovation Centre](https://www.datapolicyinnovationcentre.org/), a partnership between the Government of Odisha and the University of Chicago Trust.

My research is in Development and Environmental Economics.

You can find my recent work on the [research](research.qmd) page and
download my [CV](cv_aug_26.pdf).

My email is menna[dot]bishop[at]warwick.ac.uk.
